user.title: Welcome to HomePrep
user.description: HomePrep will guide you through a quick setup so your household profile and first preparedness targets are ready immediately. Everything can be changed later from the HomePrep sidebar panel.

household.title: Household
household.description: Tell HomePrep who and what you are preparing for.

targets.title: Starter targets
targets.description: Choose the official {authority}-based recommendations you want HomePrep to adopt as your first personal targets. These become editable personal targets; the official recommendation remains unchanged.

review.title: Ready to prepare
